question: Which building-record fields does the mode-two city production menu consume before appending IDs 100 through 122?

scope.boundary: This packet assigns three local menu-gate fields and their exact initialized values. It does not close all conditions in the generator, live menu contents, other producers, or implemented building effects.

dependencies.use: Establishes the production child, mode-two building route, and count initialized to 23.
Provides accepted record addresses, names, text, and production factors.
Establishes ordinary completed-building bits in city word +0x10; this menu loop reads the same word.
Provides accepted ordinary technology ownership query 0x82CEF6A8 used here with building +0x42.

fieldUse.technologyId: At 0x82CEC878, the loop reads signed halfword record +0x42. If it is not -1, 0x82CEC898 calls 0x82CEF6A8 with that value and the signed city owner; a zero result skips the candidate. This is a local technology ownership prerequisite, not the complete admission rule.
fieldUse.existingBit: At 0x82CEC8AC through 0x82CEC8C0, the loop rejects the candidate when city word +0x10 already contains 1 shifted by normalized building index. The ordinary completion writer sets such bits for non-spaceship buildings; special indices 19 through 22 have a distinct completion path.
fieldUse.forbiddenBits: At 0x82CEC8C8 through 0x82CEC8E0, a nonzero record +0x48 word is ANDed with city word +0x10; any matching bit skips the candidate. The mask names no particular dependency without a separate producer/consumer join.
fieldUse.requiredBits: At 0x82CEC8E0 through 0x82CEC8FC, a nonzero record +0x44 word is ANDed with city word +0x10; no matching bit skips the candidate. The condition requires at least one matching bit, not necessarily every mask bit.
fieldUse.special: Normalized indices 19 through 22 take additional spaceship-part conditions at 0x82CEC8FC through 0x82CEC9C8. Indices 17, 6, 15, 2, and 13 take separate city-state count checks at 0x82CEC9C8 through 0x82CECA18. These branches are additional gates and do not turn stored description text into an implemented effect.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only Ghidra exact-word query for all 23 accepted record addresses at +0x40/+0x44/+0x48 and two bounded raw-word windows over the consumer. Generated-code corroboration was restricted to the 0x82CEC878 through 0x82CECA4C branch of exact function 0x82CEBC38 because Ghidra truncates its decompilation.

guards: Do not treat a passed technology or mask check as sufficient for menu admission.
Do not turn the +0x44 and +0x48 masks into named building dependencies without a separate bit-owner join.
Do not infer that spaceship-part records use the ordinary completion-bit path.
Do not infer gameplay effects from stored building descriptions or menu availability.
conclusion: The building-choice loop consumes signed technology ID +0x42 and two city building-bit masks at +0x44 and +0x48 from each accepted record; exact initialized values for IDs 100 through 122 are recorded. These are local menu admission checks. Other branch conditions, live results, and implemented effects remain separate.
